question: The mass number of potassium is ______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**39.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We know that** mass no. is given as**,

 
 
• Mass no.= No. of protons + No. of neutrons.
 
 
 
• **Potassium has an atomic number of 19**, and an element's atomic number is determined by how many protons it contains.
 
• Hence, **potassium contains 19 protons.**
 
• **Twenty neutrons** make up potassium.
 
• The **mass number of potassium is calculated **using the formula above as,
 
 
• Mass no. = 20+19=39. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Potassium is a member of the alkali group of the periodic table.
 
 
• Symbol: K.
 
• Atomic number: 19.
 
• Belongs to group 1 in the periodic table.
 
• First isolated in 1807 by Humphry Davy.
 
• Sodium and Potassium are the elements known as soft metals(can cut with a knife with little force).
 
• Potassium metal is kept in kerosene due to its high reactivity with water.
 
• Potassium bicarbonate is the chemical used in fire extinguishers.
 
• Potassium is the most common radioisotope in the human body.
 
• Potassium is the second least dense metal after lithium.
